list.intro: What you spend on the business, bill by bill: a delivery, a repair, cleaning, fees…
list.costsNote: Product costs use your running costs; the expenses here count in your real profit.
list.approvalOn: Expenses need approval before they're final.
list.waiting: Expenses are waiting for your approval.
list.draftsWaiting: Drafts entered by your team are waiting for you to finalize them.
list.ownAmounts: Your own expenses show their amounts in {{tab}}.
list.booksClosed: The books are closed up to {{date}}. Nothing dated on or before it can be finalized or reversed.

empty.title: No expenses yet
empty.body: Enter what you pay for the business, like a delivery bill or a repair, with a photo of the receipt. Its category shows where the money goes.
empty.viewer: No expenses have been entered yet.

filters.noMatchesHint: Change the filters or clear them.

editor.intro: A draft changes nothing. Once it's final, it counts in your expenses.
editor.introApproval: A draft changes nothing. Send it for approval: once it's approved and final, it counts in your expenses.
editor.supplierHint: Optional. Needed when it's on credit.
editor.receiptHint: A photo or PDF of the bill or receipt, up to 10 MB.
editor.copiedFrom: This draft corrects an expense that was reversed. Fix it, then finalize it.
editor.rejectedSendAgain: Change what's needed, then send it again.
editor.rejectedFinalize: Change what's needed, then finalize it.
editor.rejectedBackTo: It went back to {{name}} to change.
editor.rejectedOtherSend: You can also change it here and send it again.
editor.rejectedOtherFinalize: You can also fix it here and finalize it yourself.
editor.savedNotSent: Saved as a draft, not sent: {{reason}}
editor.savedNotFinalized: Saved as a draft, not finalized: {{reason}}
editor.vatNotReclaimableHint: Turn this on if you can't get this VAT back. It then counts in what this expense cost the business.

errors.categoryGone: This category isn't in your list any more. Choose another.
errors.periodMonth: Pick a month from 12 months before the bill's date to 1 month after it.

editor.introWaits: A draft changes nothing. Save it: someone who may finalize expenses will finalize it, and then it counts in the business's expenses.
editor.periodMonthHint: The month this bill is for. This month's electricity bill often comes next month.
editor.periodMonthNextHint: {{category}} bills usually come the month after, so the month before the bill's date is chosen. Change it if needed.
editor.periodClosed: The books are closed for {{month}}: pick a later month.

view.title: Expense of {{date}}
view.notFoundBody: It was discarded, or the link is wrong.
view.draftNote: This is a draft: it changes nothing until it's finalized.
view.draftLocked: This expense has amounts your role doesn't show, so it can't be edited here.
view.submittedNote: Sent for approval on {{date}} by {{name}}. It can't be changed while it waits.
view.approvedNote: Approved on {{date}} by {{name}}. Approving alone doesn't count it in your expenses; it counts once it's finalized.
view.rejectedBackTo: It went back to {{name}} to change.
view.reversedNote: Reversed on {{date}}. It no longer counts in your expenses.
view.vatInCost: The VAT is part of the cost (it can't be reclaimed).
view.vatOutOfCost: The VAT isn't part of the cost (you reclaim it).
view.reverseFirst: To reverse this expense, reverse its payments first.
view.draftWaits: This draft waits for someone who may finalize expenses. It changes nothing until then.
view.paidByYou: You paid this from your own money.

confirm.finalizeBody: It counts in your expenses from now: {{amount}} for {{category}}.
confirm.finalizeApproveNote: You approve it too: your approval is recorded with it.
confirm.finalizeNote: A final expense can't be edited. If something is wrong later, you can reverse it or correct it.
confirm.payerLeft: The person who paid for it is no longer a member of the business. Ask someone who enters expenses to choose who paid, then finalize it.
confirm.submitBody: Someone who approves expenses looks at it: {{amount}} for {{category}}.
confirm.submitNote: It can't be changed while it waits. If it's rejected, you can change it and send it again.
confirm.approveBody: You approve it as it is: {{amount}} for {{category}}. Approving alone doesn't count it in your expenses; it counts once it's finalized.
confirm.rejectBody: It goes back to {{name}} to change or discard. Nothing counts.
confirm.rejectBodyFormer: It goes back as a draft to change or discard. Nothing counts.
confirm.rejectReasonHint: Optional. The person who entered it reads this.
confirm.reverseBody: It will be as if it was never entered: {{amount}} for {{category}} no longer counts in your expenses.
confirm.reverseNote: It stays in your list, marked reversed.
confirm.correctBody: It is reversed and a copy opens as a new draft. Fix the copy and finalize it.
confirm.corrected: Expense reversed. Here is the copy to fix.
confirm.discardBody: It's deleted with its receipts. Nothing else changes: a draft never counted.
confirm.discardRejectedBody: It's deleted with its receipts. Nothing else changes: it never counted.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: One list for expenses and running costs. Rename, archive or add as you need.
categories.archivedHint: An archived category stays on what already has it, but isn't offered for new ones.
categories.billedNextMonth: Its bills come the month after
categories.billedNextMonthHint: A new expense in it is for the month before its bill's date, like electricity. You can still change it on each expense.

running.question: What do you pay to run your business?
running.intro: What you pay regularly, like rent, salaries and electricity, whether or not you enter each bill. BizCost turns each one into a monthly amount.
running.quickHint: Tap one to add it with its amount.
running.monthlyTotalHint: What you pay now, each turned into a monthly amount.

empty.title: No running costs yet
empty.body: Start with what you pay every month, like rent or salaries. Tap one above, then type how much you pay and how often.
empty.viewer: No running costs have been added yet.

running.noMatchesHint: Change the search or what to show.

sheet.newDescription: Something you pay regularly to run the business.
sheet.editDescription: Change it, or say when you stopped paying it.
sheet.name: What is it?
sheet.nameHint: In any language, the way you call it.
sheet.endsOnHint: Optional: the first day you no longer pay it; it stops counting that day. Leave it empty while you still pay it.
sheet.endsBeforeStart: This is before the day it started.
sheet.removeBody: Use this for one added by mistake. For one you stopped paying, set the day it stopped instead: it then stays in your list.

mine.intro: Expenses you entered or paid from your own money, with their amounts.
mine.emptyBody: They show here once you enter an expense or pay for something from your own money.
mine.owedCount_one: {{count}} purchase or expense not paid back yet
mine.owedCount_other: {{count}} purchases and expenses not paid back yet
